content.text: In Zimbabwe, where Stripe is severely restricted, creators struggle to sell ebooks, courses, and digital products online without being locked out of their own money. To break this architecture barrier, you can host your store on GitHub Pages, a free platform that doesn't require a Stripe account or any payment processing intermediary. This setup uses NOWPayments for seamless crypto payment processing, ensuring you own your sales data and don't rely on platforms that can freeze your funds. Today, we'll dissect this solution and take a closer look at the infrastructure behind a sovereign digital product store.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

The automated delivery pipeline for digital products follows a specific sequence that eliminates every manual step. A buyer visits the storefront, selects a product, and initiates payment. The checkout displays a QR code with the exact wallet address and payment amount in their chosen cryptocurrency, converted from USD at the current exchange rate via live price feeds. The buyer sends the payment from their wallet. NOWPayments monitors the blockchain and detects the incoming transaction within seconds of broadcast. When the transaction receives sufficient confirmations on-chain, NOWPayments fires a webhook to your Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script endpoint. The backend verifies the payment amount, confirms the transaction hash on the blockchain directly, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the download link to the buyer's email address. Total time from payment confirmation to delivery email: under 30 seconds in almost all cases.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, this setup uses GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for seamless crypto payment processing. When a customer purchases a digital product, the transaction is processed automatically, and the payment is confirmed on-chain. The NOWPayments webhook then triggers the delivery of the digital product, ensuring a seamless and hassle-free experience for both you and your customers.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure solution is designed for digital creators who want to sell ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital products without relying on platforms that can restrict their access to their sales revenue. By using NOWPayments and GitHub Pages, creators can take control of their sales data and own their digital product stores, reducing their dependence on intermediaries and third-party services.
A sovereign digital product store is not just a workaround, but a base-layer infrastructure solution.
